desc: a leaf reports a wrong parent depth
the terminator edge has the key 0
an internal edge records the first suffix instead of the leftmost occurrence
the repeated-leaf check of the file-backed Traverse is removed (reverts the fix of 1b.8)
old: if (seen is not null) MarkLeaf(seen, sa[a], n);

desc: the mapped walk does not check that a child interval is not empty
old: if (mapped && (b < a || b > f.Rb || (next >= 0 && (next <= f.NextBoundary || next > f.Rb)))) throw DamagedChildTable();
new: if (mapped && (b > f.Rb || (next >= 0 && (next <= f.NextBoundary || next > f.Rb)))) throw DamagedChildTable();

desc: the mapped walk accepts a child as deep as its parent
old: if (mapped && (ell <= f.Ell || ell > n)) throw DamagedChildTable();
new: if (mapped && (ell < f.Ell || ell > n)) throw DamagedChildTable();

desc: the first l-index at the left bound of an interval is accepted
old: if (first <= lb || first > rb) throw DamagedChildTable();
new: if (first < lb || first > rb) throw DamagedChildTable();

desc: a suffix-array entry below zero reaches the bitmap of the repeated-leaf check
old: if ((uint)position > (uint)n) throw new InvalidDataException("the suffix array holds a position outside the text
new: if (position > n) throw new InvalidDataException("the suffix array holds a position outside the text
